# Rendered by scripts/relay-failover.mjs. Credentials come from /etc/ferryx/litestream.env

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Refreshes a warm standby's account database from the Litestream replica.
#
# Runs only while the data directory carries the standby marker (`standby.readonly`). A
# promoted host has no marker, so a stray timer run can never overwrite a writable database.
# The restore lands in a temporary file in the same directory and replaces the live file with
# an atomic rename; the relay opens a fresh SQLite connection per request, so the next read
# sees the new copy.
#
# Usage: ferryx-standby-restore.sh <account data dir> [litestream config]
set -euo pipefail

DATA_DIR="${1:?usage: ferryx-standby-restore.sh <account data dir> [litestream config]}"
CONFIG="${2:-/etc/litestream.yml}"
DB="$DATA_DIR/account-store.sqlite3"
MARKER="$DATA_DIR/standby.readonly"

if [[ ! -f "$MARKER" ]]; then
  echo "ferryx-standby-restore: $MARKER is absent; this host is writable, refusing to restore" >&2
  exit 0
fi

tmp="$(mktemp "$DATA_DIR/.restore.XXXXXXXX")"
rm -f "$tmp"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp" "$tmp-wal" "$tmp-shm"' EXIT

litestream restore -config "$CONFIG" -if-replica-exists -o "$tmp" "$DB"
if [[ ! -f "$tmp" ]]; then
  echo "ferryx-standby-restore: no replica yet; keeping the current copy" >&2
  exit 0
fi

chmod 600 "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$DB"
rm -f "$DB-wal" "$DB-shm"
echo "ferryx-standby-restore: refreshed $DB"

# Same unit name as the primary on omarchy (`ferryx-relay.service`). The deploy plan installs it
# on the warm standby together with the `standby.conf` drop-in; environment that differs per host
# lives in drop-ins and private EnvironmentFiles, never in this file.
[Unit]
Description=Ferryx Relay & Account Service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=ferryx
WorkingDirectory=/
Environment=FERRYX_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=commercial
Environment=FERRYX_ACCOUNT_ORIGIN=https://relay.ferryx.dev
Environment=FERRYX_ACCOUNT_RELAY_ORIGIN=https://relay.ferryx.dev
Environment=FERRYX_ACCOUNT_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/ferryx/account-data
Environment=FERRYX_RELAY_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/ferryx/relay
Environment=FERRYX_UI_DIST_DIR=/var/lib/ferryx/ui-dist
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/ferryx/relay.env
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/ferryx-relay --port 8787
Restart=always
RestartSec=3s
LimitNOFILE=65535

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=Refresh the Ferryx warm-standby account database from Litestream
ConditionPathExists=/var/lib/ferryx/account-data/standby.readonly

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=ferryx
EnvironmentFile=/etc/ferryx/litestream.env
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/ferryx-standby-restore.sh /var/lib/ferryx/account-data /etc/litestream.yml

[Unit]
Description=Refresh the Ferryx warm-standby account database every minute

[Timer]
OnBootSec=30s
OnUnitActiveSec=60s
AccuracySec=5s

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# Continuous replication of the account database. Enabled on the primary only; on the
# standby it stays disabled until `relay-failover.mjs promote-standby` enables it.
[Unit]
Description=Litestream replication of the Ferryx account database
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=ferryx
EnvironmentFile=/etc/ferryx/litestream.env
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/litestream replicate -config /etc/litestream.yml
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
